notes: Definition change, equivalent: in `XcLatF` the predicate `Submodule.IsLattice E (XcF X 𝔄 cu)` becomes `Submodule.IsFullLattice E (XcF X 𝔄 cu)`. The module compiles unchanged, but Mathlib #44365 renamed the pinned `IsLattice` (finitely generated and spanning) to `IsFullLattice` and reused the name `IsLattice` for a weaker notion without `span_eq_top`, so the unchanged text would silently state the weaker notion. Here `XcF X 𝔄 cu : Submodule (𝓞 E) (Fin ρ → E)` and `E` is a number field, the fraction field of `𝓞 E`, so `IsFullLattice E M ↔ M.FG ∧ span E M = ⊤`, which is the pinned definition, because `Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg` supplies the new linear-independence field.
